description: Source code for the 'torch::jit::mobile::nnc' namespace, implementing classes and functions related to neural network compilation, including InputSpec, OutputSpec, MemoryPlan, Function, and CompilationUnit, with serialization, validation, and execution logic.

classes.name: InputSpec
classes.description: Represents input tensor specifications including size and data type, with methods for serialization and validation.

classes.name: OutputSpec
classes.description: Represents output tensor specifications including size, data type, and quantization parameters, with methods for serialization and allocation.

classes.name: MemoryPlan
classes.description: Defines memory buffer sizes and manages their allocation within an execution state.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Encapsulates a neural network function, including serialization, execution, and state initialization.

classes.name: CompilationUnit
classes.description: Manages a collection of functions, supports serialization, and runs functions by name with given inputs.

methods.name: InputSpec
methods.description: Constructor that initializes input specifications from a c10::IValue.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the InputSpec to a c10::IValue.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given tensor against the input specification.

methods.name: OutputSpec
methods.description: Constructor that initializes output specifications from a c10::IValue.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the OutputSpec to a c10::IValue.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates an output tensor based on the specification, handling quantized types.

methods.name: MemoryPlan
methods.description: Constructor that initializes memory buffer sizes from a c10::IValue.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the MemoryPlan to a c10::IValue.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory buffers for the execution state.

methods.name: Function
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a function from a c10::IValue, including parameters, input/output specs, and memory plan.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Function to a c10::IValue.

methods.name: init_execution_state
methods.description: Initializes the execution state, allocating memory and setting up arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the function with given inputs, managing input validation, argument setup, kernel execution, and output collection.

methods.name: CompilationUnit
methods.description: Constructor that initializes from a c10::IValue, registering functions.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the CompilationUnit to a c10::IValue.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a registered function by name with specified inputs.

methods.name: register_function
methods.description: Registers a new function in the compilation unit.

methods.name: find_function
methods.description: Finds a function by its qualified name.
